subject.title: fix: reject unsafe Mattermost API path segments

question: Must this security-boundary PR provide controlled HTTP or live Mattermost after-fix proof, or is the mocked pre-transport coverage sufficient for an explicit proof override?
rationale: The implementation and tests appear coherent, but repository policy makes real behavior evidence a merge gate for external PRs and the current evidence never observes a real transport boundary.

options.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
options.body: Request redacted terminal output showing a valid `/api/v4` request and no outbound request for an unsafe path.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: A qualified maintainer may explicitly accept the mocked boundary evidence if it fully establishes the security property.

recommendation.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
